claims: Kennesaw State University (KSU) is a public university.
Kennesaw State University has two main campuses.
Kennesaw State University's two main campuses are located in suburban Cobb County, Georgia.
Kennesaw State University's two main campuses are roughly 15-20 miles northwest of Atlanta.
Kennesaw State University's main campus is in Kennesaw at 1000 Chastain Road, Kennesaw, GA 30144.
Kennesaw State University's second campus is in Marietta at 1100 South Marietta Pkwy, Marietta, GA 30060.
Kennesaw State University's Kennesaw Campus is often referred to as the main campus.
Kennesaw State University's Kennesaw Campus is located near the historic Kennesaw Mountain National Battlefield Park.
Kennesaw State University's Marietta Campus was formerly Southern Polytechnic State University.
Kennesaw State University's Marietta Campus serves as the home for many engineering and technical programs.
Both campuses of Kennesaw State University are within the metro Atlanta area
